en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | The Binding of Isaac AI-music backlash, GTA VI cuts, and Nvidia hotfix trouble

entries.headline: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ pulls undisclosed AI music after backlash
entries.summary: PC Gamer reports that the Repentance+ update used undisclosed AI music in its GTA-inspired Crime Mode challenge. Recent Steam reviews fell to 8% positive at the time of the report, and the music was subsequently removed.
entries.verification: Based on PC Gamer’s full report. The 8% figure is a time-bound Steam snapshot, and no undisclosed production details are inferred.
entries.timeNote: Published by PC Gamer at 9:11 AM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Original METAL GEAR SOLID can hand its M1 tank boss to controller two
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that the 1998 METAL GEAR SOLID can let a second controller operate the M1 tank in New Game+. The discovery requires 14 inputs within 30-frame intervals, and the demonstration used a macro.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full report. The behavior is described as a hidden control path, not a finished two-player mode.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 1:28 PM Beijing time on November 22, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: ギルド探求団へようこそ！ turns 1,000 days of records into a 78-person mystery
entries.summary: AUTOMATON’s feature examines a document-driven detective puzzle in which players reconstruct 78 adventurers, 20 parties, and their fates from 1,000 days of guild records. It also highlights the relationships and emotions implied between the files.
entries.verification: Based on AUTOMATON’s full feature; all numbers and observations stay within the article’s explicit account.
entries.timeNote: Published by AUTOMATON at 3:09 PM Beijing time on November 22, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: GTA VI developer honors his late mother with an in-game memorial
entries.summary: IGN reports that Rockstar QA developer Matt Green described how his mother helped set him on a path into game development. After she died eight months before launch, the team added her name to a memorial wall in Leonida.
entries.verification: Based on IGN’s report relaying Green’s public account. This entry does not extend the report to other memorials.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN at 7:23 AM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Rockstar explains why GTA VI cut darts and bowling
entries.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told VGC that the team did not have unlimited time or money and would not include interactions that missed its quality bar. Darts and bowling were among the activities left out.
entries.verification: Based on IGN’s full relay of the identifiable VGC interview with Rob Nelson; it is not presented as a separate Rockstar announcement.
entries.timeNote: Published by IGN at 4:37 AM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Yoshinori Kitase discusses rebuilding FINAL FANTASY VII for a new era
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that original director and remake-series producer Yoshinori Kitase gave a G-STAR 2026 talk in Korea about how FINAL FANTASY VII was reconstructed for a new era.
entries.verification: Based on the pinned 4Gamer page snapshot. No design details beyond the identified speaker, event, and talk topic are added.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 11:46 AM Beijing time on November 22, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: HITORIASOBI blends deckbuilding with a 3D board and a revealing second run
entries.summary: 4Gamer’s WePlay 2026 hands-on describes Rinachi commanding toy soldiers in a deckbuilding roguelike and 3D board game. Its second playthrough reveals the words hidden in the title, while the developer interview addresses the story’s darker inspiration.
entries.verification: Based on the pinned 4Gamer hands-on and interview snapshot; mechanics and narrative structure are limited to what the article states.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 11:00 AM Beijing time on November 22, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: 白鍵上のコンチェルト ベースヒーロー turns a keyboard and four pens into a bass controller
entries.summary: At WePlay Expo 2026, 4Gamer tried C11 Games’ unusual controller: selected keycaps were removed and four ballpoint pens were laid across the keyboard as strings, letting players hold it like a bass.
entries.verification: Based on the pinned 4Gamer floor report. The entry does not infer a commercial production plan for the controller.
entries.timeNote: Published by 4Gamer at 9:30 AM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.

entries.headline: Nvidia driver 621.35 hotfix reportedly fails to stop excessive SSD writes
entries.summary: PC Gamer reports that some recent Nvidia drivers repeatedly overwrote a log file, with extreme reports reaching about 30 GB per hour. Users said the 621.35 hotfix still showed the problem, so the article recommends temporarily rolling back to 621.01.
entries.verification: Based on PC Gamer’s full report. The hotfix result is explicitly attributed to user reports, and the 30 GB-per-hour figure is treated as an extreme case.
entries.timeNote: Published by PC Gamer at 6:31 AM Beijing time on November 23, within the fixed window.
